violation_type.title: Safety - Electrical Outlets Covered (26 TAC §747.3501(1))
violation_type.typical_finding: The electrical outlets in the areas where children are cared have no proof covers.

finding_variants.text: The electrical outlets in the areas where children are cared have no proof covers.
The play room had two outlets uncovered. The living room had one outlet uncovered.    NOTE: This was corrected at inspection when the provider put electrical covers on the outlets.
The power strip did not have outlet covers.     This was corrected when the director placed covers in the outlets.
There were several outlets not covered around the home. The outlets were in the reach of children.
One electrical outlet in the sleeping area was not covered. This was corrected during inspection.
There was an outlet uncovered in the children's playroom that was accessible. Caregiver corrected this during the inspection.
